hikes.name: Opal Creek and Jawbone Flats
hikes.blurb: An old mining road under giant cedars and firs to a 1930s camp and a jade-green pool in a rock slot.

hikes.name: Bagby Hot Springs
hikes.blurb: Through old growth along the Hot Springs Fork to hand-hewn log tubs fed by a hot spring.

hikes.name: Bull of the Woods Lookout
hikes.blurb: A ridge walk to a lookout with Mt Jefferson and Mt Hood framing a wilderness of forested ridges.

hikes.name: Battle Ax
hikes.blurb: A rocky climb to the highest point of the Bull of the Woods Wilderness, Jefferson close in the east.

hikes.name: Table Rock
hikes.blurb: Under columnar cliffs to a flat summit with a long line of Cascade volcanoes.

hikes.name: Henline Falls
hikes.blurb: An easy walk to a 126-foot falls beside an old mine shaft.

hikes.name: Henline Mountain
hikes.blurb: A steep climb to an old lookout site over the Little North Santiam.

hikes.name: Pansy Lake
hikes.blurb: A short walk through big trees and a meadow to a lake under Pansy Mountain.

hikes.name: Olallie Butte
hikes.blurb: A steady climb up a lone cone above the Olallie Lakes, with Jefferson's north face right next door.

hikes.name: Big Slide Lake
hikes.blurb: From Bull of the Woods Trailhead, a 10.0-mile round trip to Big Slide Lake, with about 2,650 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Skookum Lake
hikes.blurb: From Thunder Mountain Trailhead, a 5.4-mile round trip to Skookum Lake, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Ring Lake
hikes.blurb: From Red Lake Trailhead, an 8.4-mile round trip to Ring Lake, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Pansy Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Bull of the Woods Trailhead, a 9.8-mile round trip to the top of Pansy Mountain (5,040 ft), with about 2,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dickey Lake
hikes.blurb: From Bull of the Woods Trailhead, a 6.1-mile round trip to Dickey Lake, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Giebeler Lake
hikes.blurb: From Battle Ax Creek Trailhead, a 5.3-mile round trip to Giebeler Lake, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Sheep Lake
hikes.blurb: From Red Lake Trailhead, a 5.5-mile round trip to Sheep Lake, with about 1,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Averill Lake
hikes.blurb: From Red Lake Trailhead, a 3.7-mile round trip to Averill Lake, with about 1,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Red Lake
hikes.blurb: From Red Lake Trailhead, a 2.9-mile round trip to Red Lake, with about 1,100 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Silver King Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Battle Ax Creek Trailhead, an 8.2-mile round trip to the top of Silver King Mountain (4,891 ft), with about 1,750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Twin Peaks
hikes.blurb: From Red Lake Trailhead, a 7.2-mile round trip to the top of Twin Peaks (5,299 ft), with about 1,750 feet of climbing.
